mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.user_id, a.`read_state`, a.read_time, a.business_type, a.business_id, a.content_id, a.level, b.title, b.content, c.username, c.account FROM sys_notifications_record a LEFT JOIN sys_notifications_record_content b ON a.content_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON a.user_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(a.id) FROM sys_notifications_record a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.read_state = 0
